The '''1010 Cargo Restraint''' was a model of [[cargo netting]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. The netting cost one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per ten by ten [[Meter/Legends|meter]] section.<ref name="PSG" />
